stories.title: Ontario was warned about career college with skyrocketing OSAP growth, letter shows
stories.summary: Career Colleges Ontario flagged in a January 2025 letter to the ministry it was concerned about unusually high growth in Ontario Student Assistance Program usage at 10 campuses.

stories.title: No ‘Bains bump’ in first province-wide poll since new Ontario Liberal leader crowned
stories.summary: The survey found Ford's PC party now sits at 41 per cent, Bain's Liberals have 29 per cent support, Marit Stiles's NDP has 24 per cent

stories.title: N.S. RCMP recovered cockpit voice recorder of downed Ontario air ambulance
stories.summary: The RCMP say their underwater recovery team in Nova Scotia played a key role in recovering evidence from an Ontario air ambulance that went down off the coast of Massachusetts.

stories.title: Poeltl, Murray-Boyles preaching patience
stories.summary: It's just too early to tell if the Toronto Raptors' season is in trouble or not.

stories.title: Margaret Atwood urging Ottawa to block bird-threatening telecom tower on Pelee Island
stories.summary: A coalition backed by Margaret Atwood is urging Ottawa to block construction of a tower on Ontario's Pelee Island that they say threatens bird safety along a major migratory route.

stories.title: Stellantis talks in ‘solution mode’, Joly says after meeting automaker’s envoy
stories.summary: Stellantis, the parent company of Jeep, announced earlier this month a deal to sell its idled Brampton, Ont., vehicle assembly plant to defence manufacturer Roshel.

stories.title: LCBO deploying police to more than 40 stores in anti-theft blitz
stories.summary: Paid duty police officers, security guards and covert agents will be present at many LCBO stores as the liquor agency cracks down on theft.

stories.title: Driver in 2025 crash that killed Ontario father of 3 sentenced to 6.5 years
stories.summary: Jaiwin Kirubananthan pleaded guilty to five charges, including dangerous driving causing death, in the August 2025 crash that killed 35-year-old Andrew Cristillo.

stories.title: Ford calls ads from gambling market he opened ‘out of control’
stories.summary: The proliferation of online gambling ads was sparked by the Ford government allowing non-government online gambling companies to enter the market in 2022.

stories.title: Raptors’ Leonard out at least another week
stories.summary: The Toronto Raptors will be without forward Kawhi Leonard for at least another week as he deals with swelling in his left knee, the NBA club said Tuesday.
